issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite new models, policies, controller and three Livewire components requiring happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests.
Domain writes are done directly in the controller and Livewire actions instead of one class per use case under app/Actions/* with authorization inside.
Livewire user input does not use the required #[Validate] plus $this->validate() pattern: email uses Validator::make and name/slug/targetMembershipId have no #[Validate] attribute.
Duplicate lang keys carry identical text instead of one canonical key.
Role comparisons mix enum objects and raw values across queries and scopes, hurting consistency.
Redundant same-caller guard and verbose comment duplicate the target-not-owner check.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains zero tests/* or *Test.php hunks; no Pest coverage for requirements, validation failures, unauthorized calls, or Locked/param tamper paths required by conventions.md Livewire definition of done

review.summary: The change implements the full entities data model, policies, entity picker, and Dashboard/Members/Settings pages with correct authorization, single-owner invariant, and docs/lang updates. It is blocked by missing Pest tests and convention deviations (no app/Actions/*, no #[Validate] attributes), so it needs substantial rework before merging.
